body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「你要喺 rate limit 下處理 50,000 個 API work item，同時容許部分失敗。設計重點係乜？」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「我會用 async 同多條 thread。」

Concurrency 是吞吐工具，不是 recovery design。若五萬個 item 同時被塞進 memory，或者 timeout 後所有 worker 一齊重試，同一條 rate limit、同一個下游 record 和你的 logs 都會先出事。答案要先定義 work item 的身份、狀態和何時算完成，再決定 queue、worker 和 async 的形狀。

## 每一份工作要有可追蹤的生命週期

為每個 item 建 immutable ID、idempotency key、input snapshot reference、attempt number、lease owner、last error、next eligible time 和狀態。狀態可為 pending、leased、succeeded、retryable、dead-letter、cancelled；transition 必須是可檢查的，不能由一個 log line 猜出來。Worker 取得短 lease 後處理一項，成功時以同一 key 寫 result 和 checkpoint；lease 過期後可被其他 worker 接手，但不能把已成功的 item 再做一次。

## Rate limit 是一條回壓合約

把外部 service 的 limit 視為被尊重的 input：全域 token bucket 或 semaphore 控制並發，429／Retry-After 會延後 next eligible time，瞬時 network failure 用 jittered exponential backoff，validation／schema error 直接停到 dead-letter。不要讓每個 worker 自己猜 sleep 幾秒，否則它們在同一秒醒來又撞一次。Queue 需要有限長度、可觀察 age 和可預測的 intake；若 backlog 過大，暫停新 work 或明確告知 owner，而不是無聲加 thread。

## Partial failure 的答案不叫全數重跑

加入幾個失敗 case：service 接收了 request 但 response timeout、worker 在寫 checkpoint 前被中斷、同一 input 進了兩次、lease 遺失、和永久 invalid record。每條都要說明 resume 後結果：查 idempotency receipt、重取 lease、跳過成功 item、只重送可重試項，或移到 dead-letter 並留下原因。這是 data structure 和 state machine 的題目，不是一場誰開更多 thread 的比賽。

## 面試中由 code 講到可營運的系統

『我用 bounded queue 和明確 item state，而非把所有 input 一次開到滿。Rate limit 透過 shared backpressure 處理，所有寫入有 idempotency，不能恢復的 item 去 dead-letter，batch 可從 checkpoint 續跑。』接着提一個 trade-off：較低 concurrency 可能較慢，卻能保護下游並讓 operator 知道完成了甚麼、漏了甚麼。

## 可以被核對的 artefact

- **工程：** work-item schema、state-transition table、rate-limit simulator、resume test、duplicate／timeout／lease-loss fixtures。
- **交付：** backlog owner、dead-letter review rhythm、何時暫停 intake、錯誤通知和需要人工修正的 record 格式。
- **風險：** 一條 service 已執行但 client 未收到 response 的 case，證明 retry 不會雙重寫入。

## 延伸閱讀

[Queue 要有 dead-letter path](/zh-HK/interview-lab/a-queue-needs-a-dead-letter-path)、[Retry 成功，點解 workflow 仍然可以出事？](/zh-HK/interview-lab/a-retry-is-not-a-recovery-plan) 和 [平均快咗，P99 可以更差](/zh-HK/interview-lab/a-faster-average-can-hide-a-worse-p99)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。API、work items、rate limits 和 outcomes 均為 synthetic 教學材料；它不是對任何服務的負載建議或真實 batch 執行紀錄。

body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “You need to process 50,000 API work items under a rate limit while allowing partial failure. What matters in the design?”
>
> Half-right answer: “I would use async and many threads.”

Concurrency is a throughput tool, not a recovery design. If fifty thousand items enter memory at once, or every worker retries together after a timeout, the rate limit, downstream record and logs fail before the batch improves. Define a work item’s identity, state and completion semantics before choosing the shape of a queue, worker or async pool.

## Every item needs a traceable life cycle

Give each item an immutable ID, idempotency key, input-snapshot reference, attempt number, lease owner, last error, next eligible time and state. States might be pending, leased, succeeded, retryable, dead-letter or cancelled; transitions must be inspectable rather than inferred from a log line. A worker holds a short lease for one item. On success it writes result and checkpoint with the same key. An expired lease may be reclaimed, but a successful item must not run twice.

## A rate limit is a backpressure contract

Treat the external service limit as an input to respect: a global token bucket or semaphore bounds concurrency, 429/Retry-After moves the next eligible time, transient network failures use jittered exponential backoff, and validation/schema errors go directly to dead-letter. Do not let every worker guess a sleep duration, or they wake and collide in the same second. A queue needs a finite size, observable age and predictable intake. If the backlog grows too large, pause new work or notify an owner instead of silently adding threads.

## Partial failure does not mean rerun everything

Include failure cases where the service accepts a request but its response times out, a worker dies before checkpointing, the same input arrives twice, a lease is lost, or a record is permanently invalid. Specify the result after resume: inspect an idempotency receipt, reclaim a lease, skip a succeeded item, resend only the retryable one, or move it to dead-letter with a reason. This is a data-structure and state-machine question, not a contest to launch more threads.

## Connect the code to an operable system

‘I use a bounded queue and explicit item state rather than saturating every input at once. A shared backpressure mechanism handles the rate limit, every write has idempotency, unrecoverable items go to dead-letter, and the batch resumes from checkpoints.’ Then name the trade-off: lower concurrency may be slower, but it protects the downstream system and lets an operator see what finished and what did not.

## Artefacts that can be checked

- **Engineering:** work-item schema, state-transition table, rate-limit simulator, resume test, and duplicate/timeout/lease-loss fixtures.
- **Delivery:** backlog owner, dead-letter review rhythm, intake-pause condition, error notifications and the record format needing human repair.
- **Risk:** a case where the service executed but the client did not receive a response, proving retry cannot double-write.

## Further reading

[A queue needs a dead-letter path](/en/interview-lab/a-queue-needs-a-dead-letter-path), [A retry is not a recovery plan](/en/interview-lab/a-retry-is-not-a-recovery-plan), and [A faster average can hide a worse P99](/en/interview-lab/a-faster-average-can-hide-a-worse-p99).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. APIs, work items, rate limits and outcomes are synthetic teaching material, not a load recommendation for any service or a real batch-execution record.
